sections.text: We will review the components left exposed after liquid removal. Wet debris or insulation may still prevent inspection of retained surfaces. The next scope will identify that material work rather than assume the earlier pumping resolved every wastewater contact area.

sections.title: Remove unsuitable or obstructing material
sections.text: We will explain handling through the available crawl-space route and distinguish loose debris from attached components requiring a separate decision. Improved access may reveal additional exposure. Those findings will be described before the treatment area is expanded.

sections.title: Clean suitable retained components and address moisture
sections.text: Surfaces appropriate to remain will have defined cleaning, with related drying identified. Deterioration needing repair will remain separate from contamination treatment. A lower water level will not be used as evidence that those surfaces are ready to cover.

sections.title: Prepare replacement work from the actual condition
sections.text: We will document treated sections, source-repair status, and access limitations. New insulation or other layers should follow those findings. The handoff will distinguish the completed pumping from remediation and repair tasks still required beneath the floor.

crawl-space-sewage-cleanup/edgecliff-vil.estimate: The estimate will focus on current physical needs rather than automatically repeat earlier work. Share pumping records and drain-repair notes.
checklist: Tell us who will replace affected components.
